USE patch_inventory;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS n8n_external_auth_monitor (
id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
event_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
hostname VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
event_time DATETIME NULL,
log_time VARCHAR(32),
log_file VARCHAR(255),
detected_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
source_ip VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL,
country VARCHAR(100),
country_code VARCHAR(10),
city VARCHAR(100),
isp VARCHAR(255),
organization VARCHAR(255),
event_type VARCHAR(100),
process_name VARCHAR(100),
username VARCHAR(255),
source_port INT,
destination_port INT,
severity VARCHAR(20),
raw_log TEXT,
created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
PRIMARY KEY(id),
UNIQUE KEY uk_event_hash(event_hash),
KEY idx_source_ip(source_ip),
KEY idx_event_time(event_time),
KEY idx_detected_at(detected_at),
KEY idx_country(country),
KEY idx_hostname(hostname),
KEY idx_event_type(event_type)
);

INSERT INTO n8n_external_auth_monitor
(
    event_hash,
    hostname,
    event_time,
    log_time,
    login_type,
    detected_at,
    source_ip,
    country,
    country_code,
    city,
    isp,
    organization,
    event_type,
    process_name,
    username,
    source_port,
    destination_port,
    severity,
    raw_log
)
VALUES
(
    '{{ String($json.event_hash || "").replace(/'/g,"''") }}',

    '{{ String($json.hostname || "").replace(/'/g,"''") }}',

    {{ $json.event_epoch
        ? 'FROM_UNIXTIME(' + Number($json.event_epoch) + ')'
        : 'NULL'
    }},

    '{{ String($json.log_time || "").replace(/'/g,"''") }}',

    '{{ String($json.target_service || "SSH").replace(/'/g,"''") }}',

    {{ $json.detected_at
        ? "STR_TO_DATE('" +
          String($json.detected_at)
            .replace(/'/g,"''")
            .replace('T',' ')
            .replace('Z','')
            .substring(0,19) +
          "','%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')"
        : 'NULL'
    }},

    '{{ String($json.source_ip || "").replace(/'/g,"''") }}',

    '{{ String($json.country || "").replace(/'/g,"''") }}',

    '{{ String($json.country_code || "").replace(/'/g,"''") }}',

    '{{ String($json.city || "").replace(/'/g,"''") }}',

    '{{ String($json.isp || "").replace(/'/g,"''") }}',

    '{{ String($json.organization || "").replace(/'/g,"''") }}',

    '{{ String($json.event_type || "").replace(/'/g,"''") }}',

    '{{ String($json.target_service || "SSH").replace(/'/g,"''") }}',

    '{{ String($json.username || "").replace(/'/g,"''") }}',

    {{ $json.source_port == null ? 'NULL' : Number($json.source_port) }},

    {{ $json.destination_port == null ? '22' : Number($json.destination_port) }},

    '{{ String($json.alert_severity || "MEDIUM").replace(/'/g,"''") }}',

    '{{ String($json.raw_log || "").replace(/'/g,"''") }}'
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    event_hash = VALUES(event_hash);

parameters.command: ansible bang -b -m shell -a 'CUTOFF=$(date -d "1 days ago" +%s); NOW=$(date +%s); YEAR=$(date +%Y); for f in /var/log/secure /var/log/secure.1 /var/log/secure.2 /var/log/secure-*.gz /var/log/secure-*.xz; do [ -r "$f" ] || continue; case "$f" in *.gz) gzip -cd "$f" 2>/dev/null;; *.xz) xz -cd "$f" 2>/dev/null;; *) cat "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; done | grep -E "sshd.*(Failed|Invalid user|authentication failure|maximum authentication attempts exceeded)" | while IFS= read -r line; do ts=$(printf "%s\n" "$line" | cut -c1-15); epoch=$(date -d "$ts $YEAR" +%s 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$epoch" ] || continue; [ "$epoch" -le "$NOW" ] || epoch=$(date -d "$ts $((YEAR-1))" +%s 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$epoch" ] || continue; [ "$epoch" -ge "$CUTOFF" ] || continue; [ "$epoch" -le "$NOW" ] || continue; ip=$(printf "%s\n" "$line" | grep -oE "([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}" | tail -1); [ -n "$ip" ] || continue; echo "SECURITY_EVENT|$line|SOURCE_IP=$ip|EVENT_EPOCH=$epoch"; done'
